_about: Policy + device registry for make_ai_pack.py. Everything here is either a documented policy knob or a device fact with its provenance. Nothing in this file is a measurement of a model.

policy._max_pack_bytes: Play for On-device AI (beta, doc updated 2026-08-14): one AI pack <= 1.5 GB by compressed download size. The manifest's size_bytes is used as a conservative proxy: measured through Play on 2026-09-05, a 963 MB int8 .litertlm downloaded as 696 MB (72 %), so an int8 file up to roughly 2.0 GB may still fit; int4 files were not measured.
policy._ram_margin: A RAM floor is derived from the nominal RAM of the smallest device that verified the variant on that backend, times (1 - ram_margin). The margin absorbs the gap between nominal RAM and what the OS reports (an '8 GB' phone reports ~7.4-7.7e9 bytes MemTotal). Which value Play compares device_ram against is not stated in the doc; the margin keeps a verified device inside its own group.
policy._peak_ram_headroom: When a variant declares requirements.peak_ram_mb, the RAM floor is at least peak_ram_mb * 1e6 * peak_ram_headroom (the OS and the host app need the rest).
policy._extrapolate_soc: Add a system-on-chip selector for every verified device whose SoC strings are known, so other phones on the same SoC join the group. GPU behaviour follows the SoC's GPU; this is the doc's own example (QTI SM8750). Set false to target only the verified device models.
policy._floor_default: auto: the manifest's class-less Android recommendation (the file for 'any Android') becomes a 'baseline' group with the derived RAM floor, so phones below the smallest verified device get an empty pack instead of a download they cannot run. none: it is delivered to every device (the un-suffixed default variant).
policy._compression_ratio: Estimated Play download size = size_bytes x ratio, keyed by the quantization the manifest states (4-bit markers 'int4'/'q4'/'4-bit' first, then 'int8'). int8 = 0.72 measured through Play on 2026-09-05 (963 MB Qwen3.5-0.8B int8 -> 696 MB download); a local deflate level-6 of the same file gives 0.723, so deflate-6 is used as the proxy for other files: int4 = 0.85 (SmolLM3-3B q4 block-32, 2002 MB -> 1695 MB, 2026-09-05). Anything else stays at 1.0.

classes._about: device_class strings used by shipped manifests, in group priority order (Play serves the first matching group in the XML). ram_floor=false means the class is a SoC-generation constraint that a RAM number cannot express, so the group is built only from verified device ids and SoCs. ram_nominal_bytes is the class's marketed RAM tier; it is used as the floor only when the manifest has no measured Android row for the file on the recommended backend (the curated class is the evidence in that case).

flagship.note: 12 GB-class phones; verified device so far: Galaxy S26 (SM8850)

midrange-2023+.note: 8 GB-class phones on a 2023-or-later SoC (GPU-lineage files); verified: Pixel 8a (Tensor G3). '2023+' is a SoC constraint, so no RAM extrapolation
